ns2:course.label: Supply Chain Management
ns2:course.description: Focuses on how to manage flows of products and services from raw material sources to final customers and associate flows of information. Helps students to develop a system view of measuring channel performance, integrating cross-functional activities, and coordinating processes across organizations. Prerequisite: First year of the MBA program or equivalent.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: First year of the MBA program or equivalent.
